shortDescription: Install/update Maintenance Solution by Ola Hallengren

options.name: backup_location
options.description: Location of the backup root directory. If this is not supplied, the default backup directory will be used.

options.name: cleanup_time
options.description: Time in hours, after which backup files are deleted.

options.name: force
options.description: If this switch is enabled, the Maintenance Solution will be downloaded from the internet even if previously cached.

options.name: install_jobs
options.description: If this switch is enabled, the corresponding SQL Agent Jobs will be created.

options.name: install_parallel
options.description: If this switch is enabled, the C(Queue) and C(QueueDatabase) tables are created, for use when C(@DatabasesInParallel = 'Y') are set in the jobs.

options.name: local_file
options.description: Specifies the path to a local file to install Ola's solution from. This should be the zip file as distributed by the maintainers. If this option is not specified, the latest version will be downloaded and installed from the L(Maintenance Solution Github,https://github.com/olahallengren/sql-server-maintenance-solution).

options.name: log_to_table
options.description: If this switch is enabled, the Maintenance Solution will be configured to log commands to a table.

options.name: output_file_dir
options.description: Specify the output file directory where the Maintenance Solution will write to.

options.name: replace_existing
options.description: If this switch is enabled, objects already present in the target database will be dropped and recreated.

options.name: solution
options.description: Specifies which portion of the Maintenance Solution to install.

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.
